basic-server-commands.html.title: Basic Server Commands
basic-server-commands.html.description:
command accessibility varies depending on the world. some commands may work in some worlds but not others. any words that have % around them arent literal text and are placeholdersTeleport Commands
/lobby - Teleports the player into the lobby.
/smp - Teleports the player to the survival world.
/create - Teleports the player to the creative world.
/pvp - Teleports the player to the pvp lobby./sethome - Sets a home position for the player.
/home - Teleports the player to the set set home position./tpa %player% - sends a teleport request to the player you typed
/tpaccept - accepts incoming tpa requests
/tpdeny - denys incoming tpa requestsShop Commands
/shop - Opens the shop menu.
/sellgui - Opens the sell menu.
/sellall - Sells all of the items in the players inventory.
/shop %category% - opens the category you typed in the shopDiscord Simple Voice Chat Commands (bedrock only)
/dvc start - Starts a bot in a vc on the discord server which allows bedrock players to talk to Java players through the simple voice mod and vice versa.
/dvc stop - Causes the bot to leave the discord vc once you are done
/dvc group join %group name% - Allows you to join groups for the simple voice mod.
/dvc group create %group name% - Allows you to make a simple voice mod group.

doodlehoney2018.html.title: Doodlehoney2018
doodlehoney2018.html.description:
A photo of Doodlehoney's skin.
Doodlehoney2018 is the second person to join the server commonly called by the nickname "default" and known on discord as DePoule. He was invited to the server by TheFinnyShow and was why Air was originally called the DefaultSMP. Doodlehoney2018 has been part of several Wormhole Exploits in the past causing temp bans. Default played a big part in the server's success by inviting Austindao230, Marco, and Water Bottle. Doodlehoney's contributions are mainly inviting and encouraging people to join the server pushing people to play during many offline periods and he also wrote the artilcle for Wormhole Exploits.
One day Doodlehoney2018 threatening to destroy lots of the buildings while the server was still called the "DefaultSMP" with some negotion from Austindao230 he eventually stopped however his efforts had minimal effects due to backups being made.

how-to-craft-and-use-orbital-strike-cann.title: How to Craft and Use Orbital Strike Cannons
how-to-craft-and-use-orbital-strike-cann.description:
Items Needed The resources needed vary by recipe but the minimum requirements for a orbital strike is a fishing rod and 2 pieces of tnt.Step 1: Find/Place a crafting table. Step 2: Open the crafting table and make sure that crafting recipes are on by clicking the book icon.
Step 3: If you already have the resources its reccomended to have the crafting recipes only show items you can craft to make it easier to find the orbital strike cannon recipes. This can be done by clicking the simplified crafting table icon.

Step 4: Select the desired recipe.

Step 5: Click on the recipe and it will put the needed items into the crafting table. Once in the crafting table click on it and it will go into your inventory and turn into the desired item.Step 6: Use the fishing rod when wanted and the tnt will spawn.
how-to-craft-and-use-orbital-strike-cann.sourcePath: How to Craft and Use Orbital Strike Cannons.md

island-event.html.title: Island Event
island-event.html.description:
The Island Event was the first event ever in Air's history where players needed to collect enough beacons to escape a island. Any players when all of the beacons were collected would get the exclusive Island Rank.
A screenshot taken by Doodlehoney2018 of the island events's melon research lab Because collecting enough beacons was too much of a task players were encouraged to trade with George at the event spawn to get books with information. The books tell the player to go to a volcano to meet a sun prophet that offers Skulk Shriekers for Beacons. Skulk Shriekers can be found at a deep dark which is revealed by dialogue from the NPC's inside of a melon lab revealed by another book.George's trades required a large amount of mob heads so a gameshow was held with a spinning wheel.
A photo of the wheels available to spin in the gameshow. The Wheel to the right was optional but players had the chance to lose all of their items and bases or know exactly where everything wasa and to know how to beat the event with no need of George's books.

island-rank.html.title: Island Rank
island-rank.html.description: The island rank is a purely cosmetic rank given to whoever was online when the Island Event was completed. The only person that has gotten this rank is Doodlehoney2018

server-mods.html.title: Server Mods
server-mods.html.description:
in this article mods are modifications that change the vanilla expirence for the whole server such as plugins or datapacks. plugins responsible for features like the Basic Server Commands are not listedDynamic Lights
The datapack can be found here.This mod adds special lighting mechanics that makes the expirence more immersive such as when a player is holding a torch or if a entity is on fire.

This image is from the Dynamic Lights gallery on Modrinth.
This mod was suggested by Doodlehoney2018 and makes minecraft more immersive.Orbital Strike Cannon
The plugin can be found here.This mod adds craftable orbital strike fishing rods that you can pull to cause tnt to rain from the sky in different ways.
How to Craft and Use Orbital Strike Cannons

This image is from the Orbital Strike Cannon gallery on Modrinth.
This mod was suggested by Doodlehoney2018.Elytra Chestplate
The modpack can be found here.This mod adds the ability to combine elytras and chestplates into one piece of armor eliminating the need to switch your elytra and chestplate.

This image is from the Elytra Chestplate gallery on Modrinth.
This modpack was suggested by Doodlehoney2018 and adds a nice quality of life feature.

thefinnyshow.html.title: TheFinnyShow
thefinnyshow.html.description:
A photo of TheFinnyShow's skin.
TheFinnyShow is the founder of Air whose nickname is Air. He isresponsible for adding the Server Mods, making the website for Air, writing the article you are reading now, adding server management plugins, managing server permissions, moderating the server, and buliding the Lobby, PVP Lobby, PVP Arena, the plot and volcano in the Island Event, building the Sky Event, and brainstorming ideas for the server with GhostbusterDR.Note: There may be some bias in the article because it is me writing about myself. Take everything with a grain of salt. I know more about my own contributions more than someone elses.

wormhole-exploits.html.title: Wormhole Exploits
wormhole-exploits.html.description:
When the server first started, there were several wormhole exploits led by Doodlehoney2018 and Austindao230. These exploits were used to obtain illegal items such as Hell Arrows, Immortality Potions, and Walter White Spawn Eggs. They were mainly exploited in by using the creative mode command block in the lobby and throwing a pearl through the portal, thus obtaining creative mode in the SMP. We still do not know if there are any wormhole exploits out there to this day.
Written by Doodlehoney2018

info_linkLength.description: How long should the links between nodes be? The shorter the links the more connected nodes will cluster together.

info_repulsionForce.description: How much should nodes repel each other? This will make disconnected parts more spread out.

info_centralForce.description: How much should nodes be attracted to the center? This will make the graph appear more dense and circular.

info_edgePruning.description: Edges with a length above this threshold will not be rendered, however they will still contribute to the simulation. This can help large tangled graphs look more organised. Hovering over a node will still display these links.

info_minNodeRadius.description: How small should the smallest nodes be? The smaller a node is the less it will attract other nodes.

info_maxNodeRadius.description: How large should the largest nodes be? Nodes are sized by how many links they have. The larger a node is the more it will attract other nodes. This can be used to create a good grouping around the most important nodes.
